business_problem: Telstra needed to adapt its operations and services as AI changed customer expectations and network management, while fragmented data platforms and the scale of its organization made it difficult to execute and reuse AI capabilities quickly.
solution_summary: Telstra and Accenture established an integrated Data & AI partnership to modernize Telstra's data and AI platforms and scale reusable AI capabilities. The program consolidated data platforms from 32 to 17, with a stated goal of three, and made AI-ready data products available through shared Data, BI and AI marketplaces. AI Control Plane provides a single view of AI applications, models and infrastructure, with visibility into performance, risk and cost; Responsible AI Platform, Switchboard and Aspire provide approved models, quality data and consistent guardrails. Delivery now spans customer-care, B2B sales, fraud and network operations, alongside more than 100 live AI use cases. Named implementations include contextual generative search on Telstra.com and My Telstra App, AskTelstra over 2,000 knowledge sources, a retail Store Performance Manager, Intelligent Proposal-to-Contract, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
